description: This file contains a report generator for salary register in ERPNext, including functions to fetch salary slips, compute earnings and deductions, and generate report columns and data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate salary register report data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the salary register report, including salary components.

methods.name: get_salary_slips
methods.description: Fetches salary slip records based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for salary slip query based on filters.

methods.name: get_employee_doj_map
methods.description: Retrieves a mapping of employee IDs to date of joining.

methods.name: get_ss_earning_map
methods.description: Creates a map of salary slip earnings per component.

methods.name: get_ss_ded_map
methods.description: Creates a map of salary slip deductions per component.
